title: Vhong Navarro to pursue legal remedies on Cornejo, Lee’s impending release
summary: Vhong Navarro will pursue legal remedies after the Court of Appeals ordered the release of Deniece Cornejo and Cedric Lee, the actor’s lawyer said Monday.
